claims.location: source name + characteristics[genetic modification] + factor value[genetic modification] rows 1-6
claims.value: HEK293T_EV = empty vector pCMV-Flag (rows 1-2); HEK293T_FlagNFX1_1, HEK293T_FlagNFX1_2 = Flag-NFX1-123 overexpression (rows 3-6)
claims.evidence: PRIDE protocol: "we first subject 293T cell transfected with Flag-tag NFX1 or empty vector pCMV-Flag, then collected lysis to immunoprecipitation with anti-Flag antibodies". Construct per run follows the deposited file names (EV / NFX1_1 / NFX1_2), which match the MaxQuant txt_IP experiments EV, NFX1_1, NFX1_2. Data agree: proteinGroups NFX1 (Q12986) intensity 0 / 1.93e9 / 1.53e8 and co-IP USP9X 0 / 8.4e7 / 3.8e7 for EV / NFX1_1 / NFX1_2; NFX1 evidence in NFX1_1 Up 46, Down 15, NFX1_2 Up 16, Down 4, none in EV. Abstract: Flag-NFX1-123 affinity MS found the NFX1-123/USP9X interaction. Names used by campaign-owner decision despite the raw-header conflict (limitations).

claims.location: comment[data file] + assay name + comment[fraction identifier] rows 1-6
claims.value: Up = fraction 1, Down = fraction 2 of each IP sample
claims.evidence: PRIDE protocol: immunoprecipitates run on SDS-PAGE, Coomassie-stained, digested in gel. MaxQuant summary.txt assigns each experiment two files, _Up = Fraction 1 and _Down = Fraction 2. Up/Down read as upper (high MW) and lower gel parts of one lane: median MW of identified proteins NFX1_1 Up 76.3 / Down 31.7 kDa, NFX1_2 Up 70.0 / Down 30.6 kDa; USP9X (290 kDa) only in Up files. For EV the pattern is not seen (Up 39.8 / Down 47.7 kDa; see limitations).

Numbered per factor-value group (README.adoc:330, rule 3). NFX1_1 and NFX1_2 are separate IP samples (separate MaxQuant experiments, separate gel lanes, NFX1 intensity differs 12-fold); whether they are independent transfections or repeated IPs is not documented (limitations).
PRIDE organism 9606; HEK293T is human (Cellosaurus OX 9606).

limitations: RAW-HEADER NAME CONFLICT: each IP raw header records an original acquisition file name that differs from the deposited name: deposited 20181216__Ludayun_293T_Over_EV_Up/Down = acquired D:\RawData\201812\20181216__HF_ZHW_Ludayun_293T_Over_NFX1_Ub_Up/Down.raw; deposited _NFX1_1_Up/Down = acquired ..._Over_NFX1_Up/Down; deposited _NFX1_2_Up/Down = acquired ..._Over_EV_Up/Down. Data support the deposited names: NFX1 intensity 0 / 1.93e9 / 1.53e8 and co-IP USP9X 0 / 8.4e7 / 3.8e7 for deposited EV / NFX1_1 / NFX1_2 (the run acquired as "EV" contains bait and prey). Sample identities follow the deposited names by campaign-owner decision (2026-11-09, after annotations/PXD012871.review.md); no author statement explains the renaming. Whether deposited "EV" (acquired "NFX1_Ub") was a genuine empty-vector IP is therefore not independently documented.

EV Up/Down gel-part assignment: for NFX1_1 and NFX1_2 the Up files hold higher-MW proteins (median 76.3/70.0 vs 31.7/30.6 kDa), but for EV the Up file has lower median MW (39.8) than Down (47.7). The MaxQuant fraction numbers (Up=1, Down=2) are kept; EV Up/Down may be swapped or differently cut.

Replicate status of NFX1_2 is unknown: it is a second Flag-NFX1 IP sample (biological replicate 2 within the Flag-NFX1 group), but independent transfection vs repeated IP of the same lysate is not documented. EV has a single sample.
Paper closed access (abstract only): culture medium, transfection details, reduction/alkylation reagents, passage number, storage temperature are not available.
